 The first stage of a journey aimed at glory. That is what Carlos Alcaraz faces in this ATP 500 Vienna 2026 , fully aware of how important it would be for him to accumulate minutes on the court that would allow him to arrive in Paris, Turin, and Bologna with ample practice on indoor hard courts and in the right conditions to achieve the key objectives set for the end of the year.
 The Spaniard will need his best tennis if he wants to overcome a constantly dangerous Karen Khachanov , who comes in with rhythm from Almaty. A complete player, with the experience and arguments to trouble anyone, the Russian performs well on this type of court and could be a significant threat to Carlos.
 It is true that they have faced each other 6 times, all resulting in victories for Carlos Alcaraz, who has only dropped two sets out of the fifteen played against the Russian. But there is no room for relaxation, also considering that starting tournaments is never easy, which is why the anticipation at the ATP 500 Vienna 2026 will be at its peak.
 What time does Alcaraz play today against Khachanov in Vienna 2026? 
 The match between Carlos Alcaraz and Karen Khachanov in the first round of the ATP 500 Vienna 2026 will take place on Tuesday, October 27 , in the third shift of the Center Court. This means he will appear no earlier than 5:30 PM, although if the previous two matches are extended, the start of the match between Alcaraz and Khachanov could be somewhat delayed. 
 Where to watch the Alcaraz - Khachanov of the ATP 500 Vienna 2026 
 The duel between Carlos Alcaraz and Karen Khachanov will be available to watch live in Spain via Movistar+, the platform that holds the broadcasting rights for the tournament and is dedicated to its coverage. This match will be broadcast on channel 64, corresponding to the Deportes+ package, but Basic package customers can also watch the match on channel 7 or #Vamos. 
 Additionally, to watch the match between Alcaraz and Khachanov live online, there is the option of the Movistar+ app, available for customers on any device as long as they have a username and password. Another option is TennisTV, whose subscribers can watch this match on demand from anywhere in the world and on any device.
